newsitem.title: USA: D&P raises rating on Tosco to triple-B.
newsitem.headline: D&P raises rating on Tosco to triple-B.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it has raised to triple-B from triple-B-minus its rating for the senior unsecured notes of Tosco Corp, which refines and markets petroleum products.
D&P said it has also reaffirmed a triple-B rating on Tosco's first mortgage bonds and has assigned an initial rating of triple-B-minus for Tosco's trust convertible preferred securities.

This rating action reflects Tosco's improving operating performance, strong market position, increasing percentage of unsecured debt in its capital structure and successful efforts to expand and diversify its business base.

Over the last three years the company's strategy has been focused on reducing the risk associated with relying on a single refinery in a single market by expanding its operational base through acquisitions.
Shares of Tosco closed off 5/8 to 76-1/4.
